---
title: "Editors"
---

The R Journal welcomes expressions of interest from experienced R users who would like to contribute as Associate Editors.

If you are interested in becoming an Associate Editor, you should directly [contact the managing editor](mailto:r-journal@r-project.org), along with a list of keywords that describe your expertise chosen from the list provided by `rjtools::keywords`. You should be experienced at developing R packages, and have significant prior experience in publishing scholarly work.

Associate Editors handle 2-4 articles per month, managing the process of obtaining reviews and writing a summary of the reviews for the Editor.

We are particularly interested in recruiting Associate Editors with expertise in the following areas:

- Biological and medical data
- Spatial statistics and spatio-temporal modelling
